title: Trump praises Philippine alliance on Manila visit
summary: US President Donald Trump basked Wednesday in the warm welcome of reliable ally Manila, part of a whirlwind diplomatic tour that next takes him to talks with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China.
